sections.title: AI Services for San Francisco Healthcare Organizations
sections.description: Production AI solutions for SF's world-leading healthcare ecosystem.

blocks.heading: UCSF Health Clinical AI
paragraphs: UCSF Health (UCSF Medical Center, UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals, UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center) is the Bay Area's pre-eminent academic medical center and one of the world's most innovative clinical AI adopters:

Clinical risk stratification: Patient readmission prediction, clinical deterioration early warning, and sepsis risk models for UCSF's large academic and community patient population — with Epic FHIR R4 integration (UCSF uses Epic) and UCSF's specific governance requirements.

Genomics and precision medicine AI: ML integrating clinical data with UCSF's exceptional genomics research programs — pharmacogenomics, tumor mutation burden, and cancer immunotherapy response prediction.

Ambient clinical documentation: LLM-powered documentation for UCSF's clinical faculty — converting encounter notes to structured Epic documentation with the caliber that UCSF's research-oriented clinicians require.
Cost: $65,000–$185,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | HIPAA + UCSF governance

blocks.heading: Digital Health Product AI
paragraphs: For the Bay Area's 1,000+ digital health companies:

Remote patient monitoring ML: AI for wearable sensor data — detecting arrhythmias from Apple Watch, continuous glucose monitoring analytics for diabetes management, blood pressure variability patterns for hypertension management.

Clinical decision support SaaS: AI tools for the physician and care team workflow market — clinical documentation assistance, diagnostic support, and care gap identification for Bay Area digital health SaaS companies serving provider organizations.

Behavioral health technology: AI for mental health apps — mood prediction from behavioral signals, therapy session analytics, and treatment response prediction for Bay Area's large behavioral health technology community.
Cost: $55,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 12–28 weeks | HIPAA + FDA SaMD awareness

blocks.heading: Payer and Health Plan AI
paragraphs: For Blue Shield of California (SF HQ), Health Net (Centene, Bay Area operations), and the California health insurance market:
Population health risk stratification: ML for California's mixed commercial and Medi-Cal managed care population — risk scoring for Covered California and Medi-Cal managed care programs.
Prior authorization AI: Automated PA for California's complex multi-payer authorization environment — incorporating California's evolving prior authorization reform legislation.
Value-based care analytics: Quality measure prediction and care gap identification for California's advanced value-based care market.
Cost: $55,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks
